snippet.title: Chronicles of the Wolf | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Launching on 19th June 2025 - Explore the cursed lands of Gévaudan in a free playable demo – now live on Steam!

Migami Games teams up with PQube and PixelHeart to bring Chronicles of the Wolf to life — a star-studded collaboration featuring some of gaming’s most celebrated talent. 

Immerse yourself in a dark and haunting metroidvania adventure, narrated by Robert Belgrade (Castlevania: Symphony of the Night, Tekken, Soul Blade), with a stunning soundtrack composed by Jeffrey Montoya, and guest tracks by Óscar Araujo, both acclaimed for their work on Castlevania: Lords of Shadow.

Adding even more excitement, Bloodless — the iconic crimson adversary from the Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night series — makes a special guest appearance, voiced by Kira Buckland (NieR: Automata, Genshin Impact, Street Fighter V).

Hunt the legendary Beast of Gévaudan and uncover the dark secrets lurking in a vast, open world filled with danger, mystery, and brutal boss battles.

Chronicles of the Wolf launches digitally on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox, and Steam, with physical editions for Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 5 arriving on 19th June 2025.

Start your journey in the blood-soaked woods and make your way to the eerie Taxidermy Gallery in this thrilling first look. Expect tight combat, challenging enemies, and gorgeous gothic environments with a dynamic day-night cycle that changes everything.
Play the Demo – Available Now on Steam


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2371890/Chronicles_of_the_Wolf/
